title: Origin story: Zephra Quinn
description: Zephra Quinn was born in the eye of the hundred-year storm, and the storm claimed her as its own. She rides hurricanes the way others ride horses, speaks the lightning's language, and appears wherever the sky is angriest — calming what she can, riding out what she cannot, wild as the weather itself.

description: Powers: Storms know her as kin; She rides the hurricane's eye; Lightning answers her call.

title: Stamina feats: Zephra Quinn
